biggest_catch: The page requires the friend to either maintain a $400/month direct deposit for 60 days OR fund a $5,000+ new loan within 60 days - this is more demanding than a simple account opening, and BFG can cancel or change the offer at any time without notice.
catches: Friend must open a new checking account with a monthly direct deposit of $400 or more that remains open for a minimum of 60 days, OR obtain a new loan with a minimum balance of $5,000 - all within the first 60 days after the account is opened.
New member must submit a Referral Rewards Coupon to Membership Services (or enter promo code RR2021 + existing member's name/email when applying online).
Valid only for the first new checking account or new loan opened with BFG; current checking account holders can't earn $50 by opening another checking account.
Excludes existing loans financed through BFG; business and custodial/minor accounts don't qualify; must be 18+.
Reward deposited to the referring member's savings account within 10 business days after the referred membership meets all requirements.
Cash reward may be considered income and reported on a 1099-INT.
Offer can be cancelled, withdrawn or changed at any time and without notice.
